HOME

SOCIAL
ONE FILM. EVERY platform.
We cut your patient films into shorts and manage your content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook, so every channel carries the same clinically approved message.

00:35 · 9:16
Know the signs
00:39 · 9:16
Inside a heart attack
00:44 · 9:16
Reopening the artery
HOVER TO PLAY · CLICK FOR SOUND
Three shorts cut from the heart attack film, made for HeartLink.

WHERE EACH FILM GOES
THE RIGHT CUT FOR EACH channel.
INSTAGRAM	Reels and Stories	9:16
TIKTOK	Shorts with an opening hook	9:16
YOUTUBE	The full film, plus Shorts	16:9 · 9:16
FACEBOOK	The full film, plus Reels	16:9 · 9:16
WHAT IS INCLUDED
Every film reframed for vertical viewing and cut into shorts of 30 to 60 seconds.
Captions burned in for silent viewing, with your logo and colours.
Your AI presenter in every format, if you have one.
A posting plan agreed with you, and nothing published without your sign-off.
Every short comes from a film whose script was drafted from NHS and NICE guidance and signed off by the clinician, so nothing new is claimed on social that was not approved in the film.

HOW IT RUNS
MANAGED FOR YOU. APPROVED by you.
Clinical content stays under your control on every platform.
STEP 01
Cut
Each film is rebuilt for vertical viewing and cut into shorts. Every short opens with a hook and leads back to the full film.
STEP 02
Caption
Captions are burned in, so the message lands with the sound off.
STEP 03
Plan
We agree a posting plan with you: which film, which platform, which week.
STEP 04
Approve
You see every post before it goes out. Nothing is published without your sign-off.
BOOK A CALL
